description: Defines the CameraStreamer class which manages video streaming from a camera device, including handling frames, messages, and connection management within a WebRTC streaming context.

classes.name: CameraStreamer
classes.description: A class that streams camera video frames over WebRTC, handles messages, manages connection states, and interacts with camera control.

methods.name: CameraStreamer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the camera streamer with specified port, camera id, and vhost configuration.

methods.name: OnFrame
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new video frame is available.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Handles incoming message as a vector of characters.

methods.name: VsockSendYUVFrame
methods.description: Sends a YUV frame over a virtual socket.

methods.name: IsConnectionReady
methods.description: Checks if the connection is ready.

methods.name: StartReadLoop
methods.description: Starts the thread to read data.
